CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. Only the volume
   C. The speed of the music
   D. Only the costume

2. Best practice when working on Wind Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Wind Musical Instruments.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Wind Musical Instruments.
   C. Practise Wind Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Wind Musical Instruments.

3. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Black, white, and grey

4. Best practice when working on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts : (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   B. Disrupt classmates during Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   C. Practise Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .

5. Best practice when working on Puppetry: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Puppetry.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Puppetry.
   C. Practise Puppetry with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Puppetry.

6. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   B. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.

7. Best practice when working on Football: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Football.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Football.
   C. Damage equipment used for Football.
   D. Practise Football with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Best practice when working on Rounders: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rounders.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rounders.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rounders.
   D. Practise Rounders with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. Best practice when working on Painting and Mosaic: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Painting and Mosaic.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Mosaic.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Mosaic.
   D. Practise Painting and Mosaic with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.
   C. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.

11. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   B. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   C. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Melody.

12. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Dance.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Dance.
   C. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Dance.
   D. Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

13. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

14. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   D. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

15. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Folk Dance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Puppetry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Descant Recorder and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
